name: fix80_signpost
verifies: fix-80 #1: a signpost arm (G3 Sign_<Place> board, gCInteraction_PS UseType None) is focused like in G3 and shows its destination (FO_Sign_<Place>: Фаринг, Монтера …) just above the board
notes: Needs a content reimport (interactiveObjects.json with kind Sign, focusHeight ~0.26). The board's origin is its middle; G3 hangs the name at (0, bounds height, 0) above it. Several arms share a post: the focus takes the one the hero faces most directly, so signfocus may be another Sign_ arm of that post. Use on a signpost does nothing (HeroObjectUse.Use refuses Kind Sign, G3 UseType None).
